certifications.description: Initial certifications the associate holds at shift start. May be empty or null (both mean "none yet" — null is treated exactly like omitting the field) — certifications can be added later via POST /associates/{id}/certifications. Each entry must be non-empty.

siteCode.description: ADDITIVE and optional (ADR 0034). The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1 -- the same identifier warehouse-planning carries as site_id) this associate works at for the shift. Omitted, null or blank all leave the site unknown (null is treated exactly like omitting the field): such an associate counts only in UNSCOPED staffing-gap queries. The code is accepted as given -- this context never validates it against facility-layout. A restart (second call for the same associate) replaces the roster entry, site included.
